workspace.description: Omit when passing worktreePath — a worktreePath review is dispatched with workspace {"kind":"none"} and has no checkout of its own.

diffRange.description: Optional git diff range to review instead of the uncommitted working-tree diff, e.g. "<merge-base>...<head>" (three-dot form). Omit to review the uncommitted diff as before.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the worktree holding the diff. When set, run every git read as `git -C <worktreePath> …` and read files under it instead of the session's own cwd. Used when reviewing a controller's uncommitted work, which a checkout of the branch would not contain.
